::: {.info-card}
Welcome. I'm an undergraduate researcher working at the intersection of **computational commutative algebra** and **graph theory** at Colgate University. I am a Benton Scholar and AMS Scholar, granting me over $10,000$ in funding over the next four years. Alongside combinatorics, I am interested in statistical modelling, data visualization, and web design. I am also a Division One student-athlete on the Men's Rowing Team.

This site hosts my coursework from **Math 240: Computational Statistics**.
:::

## Research

I study connections between graph-theoretic structure and algebraic properties of monomial ideals — particularly how combinatorial data from a graph translates into algebraic invariants. This work is deeply collaborative and has sharpened my ability to communicate mathematics clearly and rigorously.
